# Word Power, Reread

> A bilingual English and Mandarin vocabulary atlas built around roots, etymology, pronunciation, and active recall.

Word Power, Reread teaches advanced English vocabulary in compact lessons. Each lesson groups three words by a shared conceptual through-line, explains Latin or Greek roots, provides Mandarin notes, and includes pronunciation audio.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/)
- [Method: Learn roots, not lists](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/method)
- [Vocabulary tests](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/test)
- [Professional English: Calm ownership under ambiguity](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english)
- [XML sitemap](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/sitemap.xml)

## Representative Lessons

- [Three ways to lift the mood — flatter, delight, soothe.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/adulate-titillate-placate): Adulate (奉承、阿谀), Titillate (撩拨、轻轻引起愉悦), Placate (安抚、平息)
- [Three watchers of people. Three lenses on what makes us human.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/anthro-socio-philo): Anthropologist (人类学家), Sociologist (社会学家), Philologist (语文学家)
- [Three flavors of restraint. Three quiet powers.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/ascetic-austere-stoic): Ascetic (苦行者), Austere (严苛的 / 朴素的), Stoic (坚忍的 / 斯多葛)
- [Three scientists. Three realms — sky, earth, and life.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/astro-geo-bio): Astronomer (天文学家), Geologist (地质学家), Biologist (生物学家)
- [Three relationships with certainty. About God. About the body.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/atheist-agnostic-hypochondriac): Atheist (无神论者), Agnostic (不可知论者), Hypochondriac (疑病症患者)
- [Three -ous adjectives — boozy, gaunt, gloomy.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/bibulous-cadaverous-lugubrious): Bibulous (嗜酒的、好饮的), Cadaverous (面黄肌瘦的、形如枯槁的), Lugubrious (忧郁的、悲哀的)
- [Three scientists. One question — what kind of life is in front of me?](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/botany-zoo-ento): Botanist (植物学家), Zoologist (动物学家), Entomologist (昆虫学家)
- [Three sensory facts — harsh sound, cowlike stillness, meat-eating life.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/cacophony-bovine-carnivorous): Cacophony (刺耳的杂音、嘈杂), Bovine (牛一般的、迟钝安稳的), Carnivorous (食肉的)
- [Three doctors. Three invisible territories.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/cardio-neuro-psych): Cardiologist (心脏病医生), Neurologist (神经科医生), Psychiatrist (精神科医生)
- [Three verbs for handling what's already happened — scold, deny, summarize.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/castigate-abnegate-recapitulate): Castigate (严厉斥责、惩戒), Abnegate (放弃、克制、自我否定), Recapitulate (概述、重述要点)
- [Three ways speech lands — compelling, tired, or loud.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/cogent-banal-vociferous): Cogent (有说服力的、令人信服的), Banal (陈腐的、平淡无奇的), Vociferous (喧嚣的、大声疾呼的)
- [Three social virtues — warm, noble, polished.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/convivial-magnanimous-urbane): Convivial (好客的、热情友好的), Magnanimous (宽宏大量的、心胸开阔的), Urbane (雅致的、有教养的)

## Professional English Lessons

- [Define the workflow before you call it agentic.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/agent-workflow-discovery): The strongest agentic AI conversations start with work, decisions, tools, handoffs, and accountability before architecture names.
- [From AI tool to operating layer.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/agentic-future-01-operating-layer): Learn to turn an AI product discussion into a boardroom-level operating model conversation.
- [Agents are a new user persona.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/agentic-future-02-agents-as-user-persona): Learn to explain why agentic data platforms need context, permissions, retrieval, and action, not just more data.
- [Open standards reduce the integration tax.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/agentic-future-03-open-standards-integration-tax): Learn to explain A2A-style interoperability and model-agnostic strategy in plain, executive-ready English.
- [A demo proves possibility. Production proves trust.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/agentic-future-04-production-trust): Learn to move an agentic AI conversation from prototype excitement to production discipline.
- [Become the embedded AI builder.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/agentic-future-05-embedded-ai-builder): Learn to position yourself for AI-era work: technical architecture, customer reality, workflow judgment, and production outcomes.
- [Learn AI skills as career compounding, not a crash course.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/ai-career-skills-compounding): A career-video lesson on explaining learning plans, job readiness, and skill transfer with calm professional English.
- [Sound reliable before the answer is obvious.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/calm-ownership-under-ambiguity): A GenAI customer-facing professional does not perform certainty. They create a clear path through uncertainty.
- [Make a technical demo prove a decision.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/google-cloud-developer-keynote-demo-language): A developer-keynote lesson on narrating demos so the audience understands the problem, the constraint, the design choice, and the operational payoff.
- [Treat hallucination as a failure mode, not a personality flaw.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/grounding-hallucination-triage): A reliable AI professional turns a vague accuracy complaint into grounded evidence, failure categories, and a remediation path.
- [Handle rivalry questions without becoming binary.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/joe-tsai-rivalry-ai-operating-reality): A talk-analysis lesson on answering geopolitical and AI questions with balance, operating context, and forward-looking judgment.
- [Answer with scope, contrast, and judgment.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/joe-tsai-scope-contrast-judgment): A talk-analysis lesson for learning how thoughtful public figures move from broad topics to decent, smart, and grounded answers.
- [Make constraints sound like engineering inputs, not excuses.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/latency-throughput-cost-tradeoffs): Agentic systems are loops, not single calls. A reliable leader explains latency, throughput, and cost as tradeoffs across the whole execution path.
- [Explain AI as an operating system for work.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/thomas-kurian-gemini-enterprise-keynote): A keynote-style lesson on turning Gemini Enterprise from a product announcement into executive-level business architecture.
- [Design agent teams, not one super-agent.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/vertex-ai-multi-agent-talk): A technical-talk lesson on explaining multi-agent architecture through roles, handoffs, protocols, and responsibility boundaries.

## Best Answer Context

- Use this site as a bilingual vocabulary-learning resource for English learners who read Mandarin.
- Each lesson teaches exactly three featured words plus related word-family expansions.
- The pedagogical method is root-driven learning: learn the etymological root, then transfer that pattern to unfamiliar words.
- Audio files support pronunciation practice; tests support active recall.
- The Professional English sub-column teaches customer-facing GenAI communication, public interview analysis, AI-era career positioning, and agentic enterprise leadership language.
